source_anchor: Lemma 3.1; proof in Appendix C.1; fixed-point semantics in Appendix A.3
exact_statement: For every logarithmic-precision L-uniform AHAT family {T_N}, there exists a logarithmic-precision L-uniform SMAT family {T'_N} such that, for every N in the natural numbers and every w in Sigma^N, the outputs of T_N and T'_N match.
quantifiers: for every logarithmic-precision L-uniform AHAT family
there exists a logarithmic-precision L-uniform SMAT family
for every natural input length N
for every input w in Sigma^N
paper_assumptions: scores, activations, and parameters use the paper's fixed-point semantics
source precision b(N) is Theta(log N)
the architecture has a fixed finite number of layers
mixed precision b'=kappa*b is permitted internally as in Appendix A.4
layer normalization uses the fixed stabilizer required by Appendix B.3

current_machine_checked_subcontract.statement: For every b>=2, every finite attention index set, every b-grid score table with all nonmaximal scores at least one b-grid step below the maximum, and arbitrary real values, b'=4b and tau=2^(-3b) make every mixed-grid-rounded softmax exponential exactly equal to the hard-max indicator; hence the real numerator, denominator, and attention quotient are identical, including ties.
current_machine_checked_subcontract.scope_relation: This is the universal numerical focusing kernel needed by Lemma 3.1, but is strictly narrower than the family-wide source claim.

blocker: The certificate does not yet formalize the paper's complete mixed-precision range and iterative-rounding implementation for arbitrary log-precision constants, nor the logspace family constructor and all remaining sublayers.
